findings.description: `quoted()` strips only C0/C1 controls (`CONTROL_CHARS`), so invisible Unicode in ticket text reaches the kickoff unseen by the operator who approved the design: tag characters U+E0000–E007F, zero-width characters and U+FEFF, and bidi overrides. Nothing writes a `ticket` yet, so this becomes reachable once step 4's intake copies issue text in. The quote and its framing still hold; what fails is the operator's check, because the kickoff holds text nobody saw. Other prompt paths already strip these characters with `[\p{Cf}\p{Default_Ignorable_Code_Point}]` (see `FORMAT_CHARS` in fix-round.service.ts and `INVISIBLE_OR_BREAKING` in this file).

`pup review` prints each slice criterion through `sanitizeReason`, which keeps only the first 300 characters and adds no marker. `assertTicketBounds` allows criteria up to 500 characters, so a 450-character criterion appears in full in the kickoff but cut short in the review. That contradicts decision 187's "refused, never cut". It is unreachable until intake writes tickets. Fix options: strip control characters without truncating, append an ellipsis when cut, or lower the criteria cap to 300.

`editTaskSpec` copies the stored ticket into the edited spec unchanged and then runs `assertPlannableSpec`. A stored row whose ticket fails the new checks (no `design-approved` label, a bad ref, or a field over a cap) is therefore refused on every `pup plan edit`, even a goal-only fix, and no command can change the ticket. That contradicts the function's doc, which says edit is how a failing row gets repaired. It is unreachable until step 4's intake writes tickets. Either update the doc to say re-intake repairs a ticket, or let intake refresh the ticket copy.

`pup review` now prints the ticket ref and criteria, which come from the tracker, through `sanitizeReason`. That function removes C0/C1 controls but keeps bidi and zero-width format characters, so a criterion containing U+202E shows reordered in the reviewer's terminal. The merge gate already strips `INVISIBLE_FORMAT_CHARS` before calling `sanitizeReason` (merge-gate.service.ts:3536-3541). It is unreachable until intake writes tickets.

process_issues.description: Skipped review-spec: the PR closes no issue and no --spec was given; its Goal/Acceptance body was passed to reviewers as intent. Skipped review-context (no infra/protocol surface touched), review-workflow-safety (no workflow change), and review-maintainability (off the default roster). Security ran as one instance even though the diff is 557 lines, because only 188 of them are source and the trust-boundary surface is two small functions.

Downgraded the security reviewer's 'invisible Unicode in quoted()' finding from important to nit under §6: the reviewer itself conceded that no code writes `ticket` until step 4's intake exists, so the trigger is not reachable yet. Reclassified the bidi-in-`pup review` finding from pre-existing to nit, because the PR newly routes tracker text to that sink. Dropped two simplicity nits: one voided itself because the reviewer conceded the deliberate unknown-type tolerance justifies the cap; the other had no concrete cost ('clear as written').
The rule injection showed only `@` references, not the doc text, so the reviewer read general.md and testing.md directly in order to quote them.
